author: Ignotus Nemo

capacity_check.layout: The first sixteen existing authorization positions select wallet-owner or contract-authority semantics. No additional positions are reserved, so all 255 live B255 positions remain available.

timing_boundary.fixture_preparation: Builds deterministic transactions and authorization proofs for the research fixture. It is not miner block-production latency because users normally supply their authorization proofs.
timing_boundary.matrix_build_and_satisfaction_scan: Builds the complete fixed B255 direct relation and evaluates every constraint. It is not recursive proof construction.

limitations: The fixture contains 26 live user pages, the minimum occupancy selecting B255, while the relation has the complete fixed B255 shape.
No B255 terminal proof was frozen for the changed relation.
No new soundness certificate was calculated.
The measurements establish fixed-shape feasibility, not production latency or throughput.
